description: Sends one text to a chat by id: a person, a group, a forum topic or Saved Messages (the user's own chat), optionally as a reply. `chat` is a chat id from `telegram_chat_read`, never a name, username or phone number. `text` goes out exactly as written, never read as Markdown or HTML, surrounding blank space trimmed, at most 4096 characters; a longer text is several calls. `topic` names a forum topic (an id from `telegram_chat_read` `topics`); `reply_to` replies to a message of that chat by its id. Needs the sync service running. Sending files is a separate tool. A result means Telegram accepted the message, not that anyone has read it. `duplicate` means an earlier delivery of this same call had already gone out: it was sent once, and it must not be sent again. A failure `uncertain` means the message may have gone out: check the chat in Telegram (the error lists the matching messages of the user's that the mirror saw) and never send it again without the user checking.

account.description: The account label; may be left out when only one account is logged in.

chat.description: The chat id, from `telegram_chat_read`, such as 123456789 or -1001234567890. Saved Messages is the user's own chat (`kind` `self`). A name, username or phone number is not a chat.

reply_to.description: The id of a message of that chat to reply to, as `telegram_chat_read` gives it.

text.description: The text exactly as it should arrive; it is never read as Markdown or HTML. Surrounding blank space is trimmed, and what is left is 1 to 4096 characters.

topic.description: The forum topic to send to, an id from `telegram_chat_read` `topics`; the General topic is 1. Only for a chat with topics.

name: telegram_message_send

chat.description: The chat the message was sent to.

duplicate.description: Set when Telegram had already received this same call: the message went out once, and no second exists.

id.description: The sent message's id in that chat; absent when Telegram had already received it and it is not known.

time.description: When Telegram dated it, in local time with offset.

title: Send a message
